blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Some senator-judges on Wednesday expressed hope that Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team would still be allowed to present its case on impeachment Articles I and IV, which concern her alleged misuse of confidential funds and grave threats. On Tuesday, the prosecution said it would no longer pursue the two articles, along with Article III, which concerns Duterte’s alleged bribery of Department of Education officials. The Senate Impeachment Court allowed the withdrawal, preventing the defense from making its presentation on the dropped articles. Unlike Article III, however, the prosecution had already presented witnesses and exhibits for Articles I […]...
